thread:
mika: Heads-up — planning to flip the perTenantBatching flag for Europe tonight in the 22:00 UTC quiet window. Wants: safe-defaults, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. :rocket:

alex: I'm the one pushing the config PR (will merge ~20:30 UTC) and will watch the deploy. I'll tag the cloud deploy at 21:45.

jamie: I can own smoke. What's the checklist exactly? quick tests I should run? :eyes:

mika: Thanks. Minimal checklist I want: 
- confirm canary traffic to eu pool only (no global spillover)
- run 5 warmup requests to cached model endpoints
- validate latency P95 < 200ms on sampled tenant traffic
- verify KV cache hit rate doesn't drop >2%
- run end-to-end prompt through staging -> eu -> response compare (gold set)

jamie: Got it. Can you paste the flag flip command for ops?

alex: Use the feature service curl. I'll be around if anything flakes.

```
# flip to true for region=eu
curl -X POST https://feature.redwood.internal/flags/perTenantBatching/toggle \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API_KEY" \n  -d '{"value": true, "scope": "region:eu", "reason": "night-window safe flip"}'
```

alex: After flip run this quick health probe (will post script):

```
# quick smoke script (sample)
for t in $(seq 1 5); do
  curl -s -H "X-Tenant: sample-tenant" https://eu.api.redwood/v1/generate?model=rwd-7b | head -c 200
  sleep 1
done
```

prod-oncall-bot: Reminder: Quiet window scheduled 22:00-23:30 UTC. Pager rotation: @sara oncall 21:00-23:59 UTC.

sara: I'm oncall and will take ownership for any rollback. Please ping me in this thread if latencies spike or error rate > 1%. I'll trigger the kill-switch doc if needed. :white_flag:

jamie: Smoke run results (21:55 UTC): 5/5 responses returned, P95 160ms, KV hit delta +0.4%. Sending diffs to thread. :thumbsup:

alex: Merged config PR 20:32 UTC. Starting gradual flip 22:00 UTC to 10% -> 50% -> 100% (5m windows). Will report at each step.

mika: Rollback plan: immediate flip to false for region:eu + pin traffic to hosted fallback pool. If we need full rollback, revert PR and trigger infra rollback runbook: https://confluence.redwood/rr/rollback-rundown (linked).

jamie: At 22:05 after 10%: P95 170ms, errors 0.15%. Proceeding to 50%.

jamie: At 22:12 after 50%: P95 190ms, errors 0.22% (within threshold). Proceeding to 100%.

alex: At 22:20 flipped to 100% for eu. All traces look green.

jamie: Post-flip checks (22:28): KV hit steady, no regression on gold prompts. Marking smoke done.

mika: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) add a short note in rollout playbook about nightly safe flip cadence, 2) consider a pre-warm step for cold tenants that saw slight latency bump.

devex-bot: Added a checklist item to the rollout playbook page: https://confluence.redwood/devex/rollouts — entry id RBW-482.

sara: Closing watch. If any customer-facing issues surface, will reopen and escalate. Great job. :tada:
